concerns.text: Task T004 instructs the code to 'update state/projects/...yaml artifact_hashes and updated_at fields'. This violates Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline), which mandates the Advancement-Evaluator Agent is the sole writer of project state files. The task must be revised to only log the deviation and output a manifest for the agent to process, not write the state file directly.

Task T004b requires writing to 'data/derived/deviation_log.json' but fails to mandate checksumming this artifact or recording it in the state manifest. This violates Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) which require all derived artifacts to be checksummed and tracked.

Task T029 mandates including the 'fixed design threshold ()' in JSON output. The value (0.10) is missing from the parentheses. This creates an untestable deliverable that fails to satisfy SC-001 (report the fixed design threshold used) and FR-005 (flag configurations where Type I error > 0.10). The task must explicitly state the value 0.10.

Task T030 requires injecting a disclaimer into result JSONs but does not mandate that these modified files be re-checksummed and recorded in the state manifest. This violates Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) as the 'final' result files would lack provenance tracking for the modification.

Task T038 proposes a 'robust URL fallback list' for dataset downloads. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires fetching from 'the same canonical source on every run'. Introducing fallbacks risks fetching different data versions unless strictly version-pinned and checksum-verified, which the task does not specify. The task must be revised to enforce a single canonical source or strict version pinning for all mirrors.
